title: Indistructable Straw Beds
description: Makes it so that straw beds dont break when you usee them
body:
# Indestructible Straw Beds
Straw Beds are great for skipping the night without setting your spawn point — but vanilla makes them break after a single use. This mod removes that limitation: sleep in a Straw Bed as many times as you want, and get out early without losing it either.

## Compatibility

Requires Fabric Loader + Fabric API.
Built for Minecraft 26.3-snapshot-3 and later 26.3 snapshots (may work on future 26.3 builds, but isn't guaranteed until tested).

## Notes

Straw Beds still can't be used in the Nether or the End — that vanilla restriction is untouched, only the "breaks after one use" behavior is removed.
This is a snapshot-era mod for a very new Minecraft feature; expect it to need updates as Straw Bed mechanics get tweaked in future snapshots.
